name: Hikifune
tagline: Tokyo in 24 minutes and Otemachi in 24 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Sumida City, where Tobu run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 24 minutes to Otemachi, 38 minutes to Shinjuku, 43 minutes to Shibuya and 37 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 0.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 1.0 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 0.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from -0.8 m to 0.2 m, a difference of 1.0 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 9 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 3 to 5 m. For storm surge, 9 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

groceries.name: イトーヨーカドー 曳舟店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 8 clinics and 6 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 東京都済生会向島病院, about 9 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 東京都済生会向島病院, about 10 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Tobu Skytree Line and Tobu Kameido Line. Both lines are run by Tobu, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Tobu Skytree Line runs at 142% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 小菅→北千住, which this station is not on. Tobu Kameido Line is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000, 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000, 1LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 2LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

noiseSources: 水戸街道 (1 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 8 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively many of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
